description: Update one or more fields of an existing task. Pass only the fields you want to change — all are optional. Returns the updated task.

assignee_ids.description: Replace full assignee list with these user UUIDs

column_id.description: Move to this kanban column ID (use list_board_columns to get IDs)

due_date.description: New due date as ISO string, or null to clear

parent_id.description: Set parent task UUID, or null to make top-level

priority.description: New priority, low to high: MINOR, ORDINARY ("Low"), MEDIUM, IMPORTANT ("High"), BLOCKER. A board may define custom priorities — read board.config.priorities from get_board.

stage_id.description: Assign to this stage ID, or null to remove (use get_board to see stages)

status.description: New status. Default values: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, IN_REVIEW, NEEDS_INFO, DONE (= "Closed - done"), CLOSED (= "Closed - won't do"). Use NEEDS_INFO when the task is blocked waiting for clarification. A board may define custom statuses — read board.config.statuses from get_board.

tag_ids.description: Replace the whole tag list with these tag IDs (empty array clears all tags)

tag_names.description: Replace the whole tag list with these names (empty array clears all tags). Names are found on the board or created there. Max 10 per task.

watcher_ids.description: Replace full watcher list with these user UUIDs

name: update_task
title: Update task
